The '''''Javelin''''' was an [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] active during the [[Galactic War]]. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] used it during the [[Battle of Corellia]] in an attempt to destroy the [[Rift Alliance Coalition Forces]] by setting a trap. Acting as if escorting troop carriers to [[Corellia]], the ship was in fact planned to self-destruct after being boarded by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] and the [[Rift Alliance]]. However, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] and his allies managed to capture the ship instead.<ref name="Shattering" />
